SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r1.claim: Al-Samīn rejects making أولئك subject, الذين its predicate, and فلا يخفف a second predicate: the fāʾ would not modify a predicate of the relative pronoun.
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r1.anchor: فإن قوله: { فلا يخفف } لم يجعله خبرا للموصول حتى تدخل الفاء في خبره

SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r2.claim: He rejects taking الذين as a second subject with فلا يخفف as predicate: the clause lacks a linker, and saying the nouns are identical does not supply one.

SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r3.claim: The analogy هذا زيد منطلق does not help: زيد is the predicate and منطلق a second predicate, not a linked new clause.
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r3.anchor: فإن " هذا " مبتدأ، و " زيد " خبر، و " منطلق " خبر ثان

SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r4.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r4.claim: The relative refers to a specific group, not a generic conditional-like class, so its predicate does not take the conditional fāʾ.
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r4.anchor: أن الموصول هنا لقوم معينين وليس عاما، فلم يشبه الشرط

SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r5.claim: The relative clause is past in wording and meaning, unlike a future condition, so its predicate cannot begin with fāʾ.
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r5.anchor: أن صلته ماضية لفظا ومعنى، فلم يشبه فعل الشرط في الاستقبال

SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r6.claim: The correct parse makes أولئك subject and the relative with its clause predicate; فلا يخفف coordinates with the relative clause although clauses may differ in tense.
SAMIN-DURR:2:86/r6.anchor: فتعين أن يكون " أولئك " مبتدأ والموصول بصلته خبره

SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r1.claim: One parse makes هم a nominative subject and ينصرون its predicate, coordinating a nominal clause with the verbal فلا يخفف clause.
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r1.anchor: أن يكون في محل رفع بالابتداء وما بعده خبره

SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r2.claim: The stronger parse raises هم with an omitted verb explained by ينصرون, an اشتغال construction; deleting that verb leaves a detached pronoun and coordinates two verbal clauses.
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r2.anchor: أن يكون مرفوعا بفعل محذوف يفسره هذا الظاهر، وتكون المسألة من باب الاشتغال

SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r3.claim: The anonymous poem وإن هو لم يحمل على النفس ضيمها illustrates the detached-pronoun construction.
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r3.anchor: وإن هو لم يحمل على النفس ضيمها فليس إلى حسن الثناء سبيل

SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r4.speaker: ابن السيد
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r4.claim: Ibn al-Sīd argues that preceding negative لا favors an omitted verb; al-Samīn says لا is neither restricted to verbs nor more naturally attached to one.
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r4.anchor: خلافا لابن السيد حيث زعم أن " لا " النافية من المرجحات لإضمار الفعل

SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r5.claim: Al-Samīn calls Ibn al-Sīd’s preference for an omitted verb disfavored, though strong as an argument.
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r5.anchor: وهو قول مرغوب عنه، ولكنه قوي من حيث البحث

SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r6.claim: With an omitted explanatory verb, ينصرون has no syntactic position; with explicit هم it is nominative as predicate.
SAMIN-DURR:2:86#2/r6.anchor: لا محل له على هذا لأنه مفسر، ومحله الرفع على الأول لوقوعه موقع الخبر

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p703/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p703/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p703/r1.claim: Because the preceding verses describe fighting and war, the ending says they will not be helped: combatants seek victory.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p703/r1.anchor: فالآيات تتكلم عن القتال والحرب والمحارب يريد النصر لذا ناسب أن تختم الآية 86 بكلمة (ينصرون)

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r13.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r13.claim: Khizy means humiliation; al-Jawharī gives the verb khazi, while Ibn al-Sikkīt glosses it as falling into affliction. The word can also describe shame, with forms for a shamed man, group, and woman.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r13.anchor: الخزي: الهوان. قال الجوهري: خزي، بالكسر، يخزى خزيا. وقال ابن السكيت: معنى خزي

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r14.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r14.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r14.claim: Al-dunyā is the feminine of al-adnā and derives from d-n-w, nearness; its alif is feminine, and dropping its article occurs only in poetry, as in the cited line.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r14.anchor: الدنيا: تأنيث الأدنى، ويرجع إلى الدنو، بمعنى القرب. والألف فيه للتأنيث، ولا تحذف منها الألف واللام

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r15.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r15.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r15.claim: Dunyā is used both adjectivally and as a noun; as an adjective its yāʾ replaces wāw because it derives from d-n-w, as in the Qur’anic phrase about worldly life (10:24; 18:45).
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r15.anchor: والدنيا تارة تستعمل صفة، وتارة تستعمل استعمال الأسماء، فإذا كانت صفة، فالياء مبدلة من واو

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r16.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r16.speaker: ابن السراج
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r16.claim: Ibn al-Sarrāj says Najd and Tamīm write dunyā with maqṣūra alif, while the Ḥijāz and Banū Asad treat it like wāw-final verbal nouns and say dunwā.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p454/r16.anchor: وقال أبو بكر بن السراج: في (المقصور والممدود) له الدنيا مؤنثة مقصورة، تكتب بالألف هذه لغة نجد وتميم خاصة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the verse was revealed about the Jews previously described as believing part of the Book and disbelieving part.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس: نزلت في اليهود، الذين تقدم ذكرهم أنهم آمنوا ببعض الكتاب وكفروا ببعض

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r2.claim: The demonstrative points to the people who combined all the previously listed blameworthy traits.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r2.anchor: وفي اسم الإشارة دليل على أنه أشير به إلى الذين جمعوا الأوصاف السابقة الذميمة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r3.claim: As with أولئك على هدى من ربهم, after listing a person's qualities the demonstrative gathers them into one referent.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r3.anchor: وقد تقدم الكلام على ذلك عند الكلام على قوله: أولئك على هدى من ربهم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r4.claim: الذين is the predicate of أولئك.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r5.claim: Buying and selling properly involve an exchange of goods and price; Arabic extends this transaction language to meanings and choices.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r5.anchor: وتقدم أن الشراء والبيع يقتضيان عوضا ومعوضا أعيانا. فتوسعت العرب في ذلك إلى المعاني

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r6.claim: Their purchase is choosing the transient present and its adornment over eternal bliss: they give up what is lasting for what they do not truly value.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r6.anchor: وجعل إيثارهم بهجة الدنيا وزينتها على النعيم السرمدي اشتراء، إيثارا للعاجل الفاني على الآجل الباقي

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r7.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r7.claim: Such a choice is the act of someone cheated in judgment and unsound in reason.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r7.anchor: ولا يفعل ذلك إلا مغبون الرأي فاسد العقل

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r8.speaker: بعض أرباب المعاني
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r8.claim: Some interpreters of inner meanings define this world as the heart's proximate desires and the afterlife as what is joined to the Lord's approval.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r8.anchor: قال بعض أرباب المعاني: إن الدنيا: ما دنا من شهوات القلب، والآخرة: ما اتصلت برضا الرب

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r9.claim: The clause فلا يخفف may coordinate with the relative clause; a relative can have two clausal complements whose actions occur at different times.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r9.anchor: ويجوز أن يوصل الموصول بصلتين مختلفتين زمانا، تقول: جاءني الذي قتل زيدا بالأمس، وسيقتل غدا أخاه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r10.claim: He rejects the claim that فلا يخفف is a second predicate because conditional force in a relative clause does not pass to the demonstrative it predicates.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r10.anchor: وهذا خطأ، لأن الموصول هنا أعربه خبرا عن أولئك، فليس قوله فلا يخفف خبرا عن الموصول

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r11.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r11.claim: Another proposed parse makes أولئك the first subject, الذين a second subject, and فلا يخفف the latter's predicate, with the whole clause predicating the first.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r11.anchor: وجوز أيضا أن يكون أولئك مبتدأ، والذين مبتدأ ثان، وفلا يخفف خبر عن الذين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r12.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r12.claim: That parse lacks a clause-link back to أولئك; a link is unnecessary only when the predicate clause is identical in meaning to its subject.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r12.anchor: كل جملة وقعت خبرا لمبتدأ فلا بد فيها من رابط، إلا إن كانت نفس المبتدأ في المعنى

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r13.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r13.claim: The analogy هذا زيد منطلق does not support the parse: زيد and منطلق can be separate predicates or زيد can be بدل, while a nested sentence without a link is invalid.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r13.anchor: وليس نظير ما مثل به من قوله: هذا زيد منطلق، لأن زيد منطلق خبران عن هذا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r14.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r14.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r14.claim: Even with a supposed link, the parse fails because الذين is specific rather than conditional and its relative clause is past in form and meaning, so predicate-initial فاء is not allowed.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p473/r14.anchor: لأن الذين مخصوص بالإشارة إليه، فلا يشبه اسم الشرط، إذ يزول العموم باختصاصه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r1.claim: Takhfīf means making something easier or lighter.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r2.claim: The negation can mean no interruption or reduction of punishment, whether for a time or at all times; negating the genus excludes every instance and form.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r2.anchor: والأولى جملة على نفي التخفيف بالانقطاع، أو بالتقليل منه، أو في وقت، أو في كل الأوقات

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r3.claim: The apparent and usual force of lā here is future negation.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r3.anchor: والظاهر من النفي بلا، والكثير فيها أنه نفي في المستقبل

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r4.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r4.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī takes the denied alleviation as applying in this life and the next, including a reduction in jizya in this life; denial of help applies in both.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r4.anchor: وقد فسر الزمخشري نفي التخفيف بأن ذلك في الدنيا والآخرة، ففي الدنيا بنقصان الجزية

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r5.claim: They will find nobody to ward off the punishment God brings upon them.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r5.anchor: ومعنى نفي النصر: أنهم لا يجدون من يدفع عنهم ما حل بهم من عذاب الله

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r6.claim: ولا هم ينصرون can be a nominal clause coordinated with the preceding verbal clause, or a verbal clause parsed as اشتغال.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r6.anchor: ولا هم ينصرون: جملة اسمية معطوفة على جملة فعلية، ويجوز أن تكون فعلية

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r7.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r7.claim: The اشتغال parse raises هم with an omitted verb explained by the following verb; the preceding verbal clause makes this parse especially apt, while otherwise initial-subject syntax is stronger.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r7.anchor: فيكون هم مرفوعا بفعل محذوف يفسره ما بعده، على حد قوله

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r8.speaker: أبو محمد بن السيد
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r8.claim: Ibn al-Sayyid argues that after lā a verbal construction is preferable to a nominal one, and passive voice is preferable because it is more general.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r8.anchor: خلافا لأبي محمد بن السيد، إذ زعم أن الحمل على الفعل فيما دخلت عليه لا، أولى من الابتداء

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r9.claim: Abū Ḥayyān says lā neither specifically nor preferentially selects a verb, so it does not itself favor the verbal parse.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r9.anchor: وذلك أن لا ليست مما تطلب الفعل، لا اختصاصا ولا أولوية

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r10.claim: An active verb with a generic subject would state that nobody helps them, but the passive wording preserves the established verse endings and brevity while already conveying that generality.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p474/r10.anchor: فيكون ولا هم ينصرهم أحد، فكان يفوت بذلك اختتام الفواصل بما اختتمت به قبل وبعد، ويفوت الإيجاز

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p475/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p475/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p475/r8.claim: Those who bear these blameworthy traits have bought a trivial, immediate good for a noble, lasting one, choosing a tarnished transient life over a pure enduring one.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p475/r8.anchor: قد اشترى عاجلا تافها بآجل جليل، وآثر فانيا مكدرا على باق صاف

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p475/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p475/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p475/r9.claim: Their bargain leaves them with punishment that is neither eased nor warded off; they lost the trade and exchanged eternal bliss for a fire fueled by people and stones.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p475/r9.anchor: أن لا يخفف عنهم ما حل بهم من العذاب، ولا يجدوا ناصرا يدفع عنهم سوء العقاب. لقد خسروا تجارة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p475/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p475/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p475/r10.claim: If even mitigation is denied, then removal of the punishment is all the more excluded; this is an a fortiori warning from lesser to greater.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v1p475/r10.anchor: أن لا يخفف عنهم ما حل بهم من العذاب، ولا يجدوا ناصرا يدفع عنهم سوء العقاب

ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r1.claim: They preferred and exchanged the worldly life for the Hereafter, turning away despite being able to attain it.
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r1.anchor: أي آثروا الحياة الدنيا وأستبدلوها بالآخرة وأعرضوا عنها مع تمكنهم من تحصيلها

ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r2.claim: The punishment may mean the promised punishment on Judgment Day, or punishment in general, whether in this world or the next.
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r2.anchor: العذاب الموعودون به يوم القيامة أو مطلق ( العذاب ) دنيويا كان أو أخرويا

ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r3.claim: Not being helped may mean that disgrace is not removed through the end of worldly life, or that they receive neither worldly protection from the poll tax nor escape from afterlife punishment.
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r3.anchor: بدفع الخزي إلى آخر الدنيا أو بدفع الجزية في الدنيا والتعذيب في العقبى

ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r4.claim: On the first interpretation of both clauses, denial of any relief from punishment follows especially emphatically from denial that it will be lightened.
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r4.anchor: وعلى الإحتمال الأول في الأمرين يستفاد نفي دفع العذاب من نفي تخفيفه بأبلغ وجه وآكده

ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r5.speaker: بعضهم
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r5.claim: Some prefer the first reading of both clauses, arguing that the second reading would call for denying rescue before denying reduction of punishment.
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r5.anchor: ورجحه بعضهم بأن المقام على الثاني يستدعي تقديم نفي الدفع على نفي التخفيف

ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r6.claim: The subject-first order serves the verse ending and the meaning of taqwa, not exclusivity.
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r6.anchor: وتقديم المسند إليه لرعاية الفاصلة والتقوى لا للحصر إذ ليس المقام مقامه

ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r7.claim: The sentence may be coordinated with the relative clause, or أولئك may be the subject, الذين its predicate, and the punishment sentence a second predicate; the fāʾ is then explained by the relative clause's verbal, conditional sense.
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r7.anchor: والجملة معطوفة على الصلة ويجوز أن يوصل الموصول بصلتين مختلفتين زمانا

ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r8.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r8.claim: Al-Alusi objects that a relative clause's conditional sense does not carry over to أولئك when it is the subject functioning as predicate.
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r8.anchor: وفيه أن معنى الشرطية لا يسري إلى المبتدأ الواقعة خبرا عنه

ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r9.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r9.claim: A further parse makes أولئك the first subject, الذين a second subject, and the punishment clause the second subject's predicate; there is no linking pronoun because الذين are those same people, though al-Alusi notes the parse's weakness.
ALUSI-FULL:v1p315/r9.anchor: وجوز ايضا أن يكون ( أولئك ) مبتدأ و ( الذين ) مبتدأ ثان وهذه الجملة خبر الثاني

BAGHAWI-FULL:v1p119/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v1p119/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v1p119/r2.claim: To buy the worldly life for the Hereafter means to exchange one for the other.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v1p119/r2.anchor: {أولئك الذين اشتروا} استبدلوا {الحياة الدنيا بالآخرة فلا يخفف}

BAGHAWI-FULL:v1p119/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v1p119/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v1p119/r3.claim: Their punishment will not be made lighter.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v1p119/r3.anchor: الحياة الدنيا بالآخرة فلا يخفف} يهون {عنهم العذاب ولا هم ينصرون}

BAGHAWI-FULL:v1p119/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v1p119/r4.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v1p119/r4.claim: No one will protect them from God's punishment.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v1p119/r4.anchor: ينصرون} يمنعون من عذاب الله عز وجل

BAYDAWI-FULL:2:86/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:2:86/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:2:86/r1.claim: They preferred worldly life to the afterlife.

BAYDAWI-FULL:2:86/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:2:86/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:2:86/r2.claim: Their punishment is not reduced: the jizya is rescinded in this life, and they are punished in the hereafter.
BAYDAWI-FULL:2:86/r2.anchor: بنقض الجزية في الدنيا، والتعذيب في الآخرة

BAYDAWI-FULL:2:86/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:2:86/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:2:86/r3.claim: No one will repel either punishment from them.

BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r2.claim: Those described chose worldly life and turned away from the afterlife, although they could have gained it; they rejected parts of scripture to preserve benefits from their allies.
BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r2.anchor: الموصوفون بما ذكر من الأوصاف القبيحة

BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r3.claim: Their punishment will not be lightened, whether worldly or otherworldly, and no one can rescue them by warding it off through intercession or force.
BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r3.anchor: دنيويا كان أو أخرويا {ولا هم ينصرون} يمنعون من العذاب

BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r4.claim: The author likens their choice to a bad trade: one cannot attain the pleasures of both worlds, and pursuing one forfeits the other; a person who trades the afterlife for worldly pleasures is especially blameworthy.
BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r4.anchor: فإذا اشتغل بتحصيل إحداهما فقد فوت الأخرى على نفسه فجعل الله ما أعرض اليهود عنه من الإيمان بما في كتابهم

BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r5.claim: The wise should seek the afterlife, resist Satan’s commands for egoistic gain, and remain in the religion of primordial nature rather than stray into misery.
BURSEVI:v1p139#4/r5.anchor: فعلى العاقل أن يرغب في تجارة الآخرة ولا يركن إلى الدنيا ولا يسفك دمه بامتثال أوامر الشيطان

BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r1.speaker: الحرالي
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r1.claim: Al-Ḥarālī derives dunya from lowliness: worldly life is lower in rank, immediate, and opposed to the higher, delayed afterlife.
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r1.anchor: ففي الدنيا نزول قدر وتعجل وفي ا لأخرى علو قدر وتأخر , فتقابلتا على ما يفهم تقابلين من معنى كل واحدة منهما - قاله الحرالي

BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r2.claim: The paired terms work by reciprocal ellipsis: mentioning worldly life implies the omitted “higher” life, while mentioning the afterlife implies the omitted “immediate” one.
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r2.anchor: فالآية من الاحتكاك , ذكر الدنيا أولا يدل على حذف العليا ثانيا , وذكر الآخرة ثانيا يدل على حذف العاجلة أولا

BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r3.speaker: الحرالي
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r3.claim: Al-Ḥarālī defines alleviation as making something heavy and low become buoyant and elevated, like a stone rising into air.
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r3.anchor: من التخفيف وهو مصير الثقيل والمستفل إلى حال الطافي المستعلي كحال ما بين الحجر والهواء - قاله الحرالي

BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r4.claim: Those who trade the afterlife for worldly gain receive no reduction of punishment in either abode and no one can help them.
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r4.anchor: { عنهم العذاب } في واحدة من الدارين { ولا هم ينصرون }

BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r5.claim: Their lack of help is a grave warning against campaigning for booty or committing embezzlement of spoils.
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r5.anchor: وهو أيضا من أعظم الأدلة على خذلان من غزا لأجل المغنم أو غل

BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r6.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r6.claim: The Prophet says that when embezzlement of spoils appears among a people, God casts fear into their hearts; Biqāʿī transmits it from Ibn ʿAbbās through Mālik.
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال : ( ما ظهر الغلول في قوم إلا ألقى الله في قلوبهم الرعب )

BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r7.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r7.claim: Biqāʿī cites the story of Joshua: after Israel stole devoted spoils at Jericho, its troops were defeated at Ai; Achan was exposed by lot and stoned and burned with his household and property, after which Ai fell.
BIQAI-FULL:v1p183/r7.anchor: فأصابت القرعة عاجار بن كرمى من سبط يهودا , فأحضره وبنيه وبناته ومواشيه وخيمته وكل من كان له

DURR-FULL:v1p212/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v1p212/r1.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v1p212/r1.claim: Qatada says they preferred a little of worldly life to the much greater good of the Hereafter.
DURR-FULL:v1p212/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله {أولئك الذين اشتروا الحياة الدنيا بالآخرة} قال: استحبوا قليل الدنيا على كثير الآخرة

IBNABIHATIM:v1p167#2/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v1p167#2/r1.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
IBNABIHATIM:v1p167#2/r1.claim: Sa'id ibn Jubayr identifies them simply as those God has mentioned in this verse.
IBNABIHATIM:v1p167#2/r1.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير في قول الله : اولئك الذين ذكر الله في هذه الاية

IBNABIHATIM:v1p167#2/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v1p167#2/r2.speaker: قتادة
IBNABIHATIM:v1p167#2/r2.claim: Qatadah glosses “bought” as “preferred”: they chose a little of worldly life over much of the Hereafter.
IBNABIHATIM:v1p167#2/r2.anchor: عن قتادة قوله : اولئك الذين اشتروا قال استحبوا

IBNABIHATIM:v1p167#2/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v1p167#2/r3.speaker: أبو العالية
IBNABIHATIM:v1p167#2/r3.claim: Abu al-Aliya compares their unrelieved punishment and lack of help with the passage saying people will not speak or be allowed to make excuses.
IBNABIHATIM:v1p167#2/r3.anchor: عن أبي العالية في قوله : فلا يخفف عنهم العذاب ولا هم ينصرون قال : هو كقوله : هذا يوم لا ينطقون ولا يؤذن لهم فيعتذرون

IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r1.claim: The verse shows that God punishes those who deviate from the path with punishments in this world and the next.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r1.anchor: وقد دلت هذه الآية على أن الله يعاقب الحائدين عن الطريق بعقوبات في الدنيا وعقوبات في الآخرة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r2.claim: The demonstrative phrase functions as it does in 2:5, while buying worldly life for the afterlife parallels buying misguidance for guidance in 2:16.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r2.anchor: وقد وقع اسم الإشارة وهو قوله : { أولئك الذين اشتروا } موقع نظيره في قوله : { أولئك على هدى من ربهم }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r3.claim: The ending resembles 2:48, which likewise says that intercession or ransom is unavailable and that they receive no help.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r3.anchor: والقول في { فلا يخفف عنهم العذاب ولا هم ينصرون } قريب من القول في { ولا يقبل منها شفاعة ولا يؤخذ منها عدل ولا هم ينصرون }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r4.claim: The fāʾ marks consequence: so grave a crime warrants severe punishment, with no helper to avert or lighten it.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v1p592/r4.anchor: وموقع الفاء في قوله : { فلا يخفف عنهم العذاب } هو الترتب لأن المجرم بمثل هذا الجرم العظيم يناسبه العذاب العظيم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r1.claim: God portrays abandoning the afterlife and taking worldly life despite being able to hold to the afterlife as buying the world by selling the afterlife.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r1.anchor: جعل الله ترك الآخرة وأخذ الدنيا مع قدرتهم على التمسك بالآخرة بمنزلة من أخذها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r2.speaker: مالك
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r2.claim: Malik applies the exchange image in sales law: one may not buy with a condition allowing selection among units whose individual qualities differ, nor allow unequal exchange in such goods, such as slaughtered partridges.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r2.anchor: وهذه النزعة صرفها مالك رحمه الله في فقه البيوع

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r3.claim: Their punishment will not be lightened in the afterlife.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r3.anchor: ولا يخفف عنهم العذاب في الآخرة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r4.claim: They will receive no help in this world or the next.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p176#2/r4.anchor: ولا ينصرون لا في الدنيا ولا في الآخرة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v1p112/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v1p112/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v1p112/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies those people as the Jews.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v1p112/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس هم اليهود وقال مقاتل باعوا الآخرة بما يصيبونه من الدنيا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v1p112/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v1p112/r2.speaker: مقاتل
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v1p112/r2.claim: Muqātil explains the exchange as selling the afterlife for the worldly gains they could obtain.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v1p112/r2.anchor: وقال مقاتل باعوا الآخرة بما يصيبونه من الدنيا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r4.claim: Ibn Kathir condemns Jews for observing the Torah where convenient while knowingly violating its law; this makes them untrustworthy concerning its text and transmission and their concealment of earlier prophets’ descriptions of the Messenger and his mission.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r4.anchor: والذي أرشدت إليه الآية الكريمة، وهذا السياق، ذم اليهود في قيامهم بأمر التوراة التي يعتقدون صحتها، ومخالفة شرعها، مع معرفتهم بذلك

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r5.claim: To purchase worldly life for the afterlife means preferring and choosing this world over the next.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r6.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r6.claim: Their punishment is never relaxed, even for an hour.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r6.anchor: أي: لا يفتر عنهم ساعة واحدة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r7.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r7.claim: They have no helper to rescue them from or shield them against their everlasting punishment.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p320/r7.anchor: أي: وليس لهم ناصر ينقذهم مما هم فيه من العذاب الدائم السرمدي

MUQATIL:2:86/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:2:86/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:2:86/r1.claim: They chose worldly life over the afterlife, selling the latter for worldly food they obtained from the lower classes of the Jews.
MUQATIL:2:86/r1.anchor: ثم نعتهم، فقال سبحانه: { أولئك الذين اشتروا } ، يعنى اختاروا { الحياة الدنيا بالآخرة } ، يقول: باعوا الآخرة بالدنيا مما يصيبون

MUQATIL:2:86/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:2:86/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:2:86/r2.claim: Their punishment will not be lightened, and nobody will prevent them from suffering it.
MUQATIL:2:86/r2.anchor: { فلا يخفف عنهم العذاب } فى الآخرة { ولا هم ينصرون } [آية: 86]، يعنى ولا هم يمنعون من العذاب.

NASAFI-FULL:v1p56/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p56/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p56/r1.claim: They chose worldly life over the afterlife, as a buyer chooses what to purchase.

NASAFI-FULL:v1p56/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v1p56/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v1p56/r2.claim: Their punishment will not be lightened, and no one will defend them by driving it away.

QURTUBI-FULL:2:85-86#3/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:2:85-86#3/r11.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:2:85-86#3/r11.claim: Al-Qurtubi does not repeat his explanation of “Those are the ones who bought the life of this world,” since he has already discussed it.
QURTUBI-FULL:2:85-86#3/r11.anchor: وكذلك: { أولئك الذين اشتروا } الآية فلا معنى للإعادة.

QUSHAYRI:v1p55/r10.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p55/r10.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v1p55/r10.claim: Those who prefer something over God lose in both worlds; he supports the warning with a poem about those who turned away and became self-sufficient.
QUSHAYRI:v1p55/r10.anchor: إن الذين آثروا عليه شيئا خسروا في الدنيا والآخرة كما قالوا : أناس أعرضوا عنا

STUDYQURAN:2:85/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:2:85/r4.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:2:85/r4.claim: Expulsion and ransom are hypocrisy and immorality, inseparable from a degree of kufr.
STUDYQURAN:2:85/r4.anchor: Rather, the expulsion and taking of ransom are acts of hypocrisy and immorality, which are not separable from a certain degree of kufr.

TAB-FULL:v2p218/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v2p218/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v2p218/r1.claim: The referents are Jews who ransom fellow Jews from captivity while disbelieving other Torah commands, killing and expelling people whom God forbade them to harm, thus breaking the covenant.
TAB-FULL:v2p218/r1.anchor: نقضا لعهد الله وميثاقه في التوراة إليهم

TAB-FULL:v2p218/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v2p218/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v2p218/r2.claim: They traded faith and its promised eternal gardens for worldly leadership over the weak and ignorant and for meager, low-quality food.
TAB-FULL:v2p218/r2.anchor: أن هؤلاء الذين اشتروا رياسة الحياة الدنيا على الضعفاء وأهل الجهل والغباء من أهل ملتهم، وابتاعوا المآكل الخسيسة الرديئة فيها، بالإيمان

TAB-FULL:v2p218/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v2p218/r3.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v2p218/r3.claim: Qatada says they preferred a little of this world to much of the afterlife.
TAB-FULL:v2p218/r3.anchor: عن قتادة: " قوله: {أولئك الذين اشتروا الحياة الدنيا بالآخرة} [البقرة: 86] استحبوا قليل الدنيا على كثير الآخرة

TAB-FULL:v2p218/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v2p218/r4.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v2p218/r4.claim: They have no share in afterlife bliss and therefore no relief from punishment; those whose punishment is eased are those who have a share in its reward.
TAB-FULL:v2p218/r4.anchor: لأن الذي يخفف عنه فيها من العذاب هو الذي له حظ في نعيمها، ولا حظ لهؤلاء لاشترائهم الذي كان في الدنيا ودنياهم بآخرتهم

TABRISI:2:86/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:2:86/r1.speaker: author
TABRISI:2:86/r1.claim: Lightness is the opposite of heaviness; easing, lightening, and making something less severe are equivalent senses.

TABRISI:2:86/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:2:86/r2.speaker: قيل
TABRISI:2:86/r2.claim: One account explains heaviness and lightness through the decrease or increase of bodies.
TABRISI:2:86/r2.anchor: واختلف في الخفة والثقل فقيل إنه يرجع إلى تناقص الجواهر وتزايدها

TABRISI:2:86/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:2:86/r3.speaker: قيل
TABRISI:2:86/r3.claim: Another account calls downward-directed dependence heaviness and upward-directed dependence lightness.
TABRISI:2:86/r3.anchor: وقيل إن الاعتماد اللازم سفلا يسمى ثقلا والاعتماد اللازم المختص بجهة العلو يسمى خفة

TABRISI:2:86/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:2:86/r4.speaker: author
TABRISI:2:86/r4.claim: These are the people just described as believing in part of the Book and disbelieving in part.
TABRISI:2:86/r4.anchor: أشار إلى الذين أخبر عنهم بأنهم يؤمنون ببعض الكتاب ويكفرون ببعض

TABRISI:2:86/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:2:86/r5.speaker: author
TABRISI:2:86/r5.claim: They traded away the bliss of the Hereafter prepared for believers in exchange for worldly leadership and its lowly benefits.
TABRISI:2:86/r5.anchor: جعل سبحانه تركهم حظوظهم من نعيم الآخرة بكفرهم بالله ثمنا

TABRISI:2:86/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:2:86/r6.speaker: author
TABRISI:2:86/r6.claim: They have no share in the Hereafter’s bliss, and their punishment will neither be reduced nor made less severe.
TABRISI:2:86/r6.anchor: أي لا ينقص من عذابهم ولا يهون عنهم

TABRISI:2:86/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:2:86/r7.speaker: author
TABRISI:2:86/r7.claim: No one will help them in the Hereafter by warding off God’s punishment.
TABRISI:2:86/r7.anchor: أي لا ينصرهم أحد في الآخرة فيدفع عنهم بنصرته

WAHIDI-BASIT:v3p127/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v3p127/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v3p127/r1.claim: They exchanged the small gain of worldly life for the great gain of the hereafter.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v3p127/r1.anchor: أي: استبدلوا قليل الدنيا بكثير الاخرة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v3p127/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v3p127/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v3p127/r2.claim: The punishment is not reduced; khiffa literally denotes a decrease in weight.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v3p127/r2.anchor: أي: لا ينقص، والخفة: نقصان الوزن

WAHIDI-BASIT:v3p127/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v3p127/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v3p127/r3.claim: The fāʾ links this clause to their act of buying, making it part of the relative description of those people.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v3p127/r3.anchor: ودخلت الفاء في قوله: {فلا يخفف عنهم العذاب} للعطف على (اشتروا)

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:2:86/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:2:86/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:2:86/r1.claim: Their punishment is not lightened either in this world or in the next.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:2:86/r1.anchor: معناه: في الدنيا والآخرة، وقيل: هذه الحالة مختصة بالآخرة

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:2:86/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:2:86/r2.speaker: قيل
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:2:86/r2.claim: An alternative reported view restricts the unlightened punishment to the afterlife.

ELMALILI:2:86/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:2:86/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:2:86/r1.claim: “Those” are the Israelites bearing the stated corrupt traits and others like them.
ELMALILI:2:86/r1.anchor: İşte bunlar, bu çirkin evsâf ile muttasıf olan Benî İsrâil ve bunlara benzeyenler

ELMALILI:2:86/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:2:86/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:2:86/r2.claim: They gave up the hereafter to purchase the lowly worldly life, forfeiting their future share in the hereafter and its felicity.
ELMALILI:2:86/r2.anchor: öyle güruhtur ki bunlar âhireti verip dünya denilen alçak hayatı satın almışlardır. Bunların âhirete imanları, istikbâlde hakları kalmamıştır.

ELMALILI:2:86/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:2:86/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:2:86/r3.claim: Their punishment will never be eased, and no one will help them; their bargain earns only eternal loss and abandonment.
ELMALILI:2:86/r3.anchor: ileride bunların çekecekleri azab asla hafiflendirilmez.

ELMALILI:2:86/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:2:86/r4.speaker: author
ELMALILI:2:86/r4.claim: Dunyā is the feminine of the comparative from dunū or danāʾa, meaning nearest or very low.
ELMALILI:2:86/r4.anchor: “Dünyâ”, دُنُو veya دَنَائَت’den أَدْنَى ism-i tafdîlinin müennesi olup en yakın yahut pek alçak mânasına bir sıfattır.

ELMALILI:2:86/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:2:86/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:2:86/r5.claim: Although dunya can be a noun opposed to the hereafter, the Qur'an uses it adjectivally in “al-hayāt al-dunyā”: the lowly or presently nearest life.
ELMALILI:2:86/r5.anchor: Kur’an’da bu mâna hep الْحَيٰوة الدُّنْيَا terkîb-i vasfîsiyle îrad edilmiştir. Binâen‘aleyh “hayât-ı dünya” dünyânın hayatı değil

ELMALILI:2:86/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:2:86/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:2:86/r6.claim: Their covenant breaking and listed sins stem from having sold the hereafter and lost faith in it.
ELMALILI:2:86/r6.anchor: satmış olmalarından ve âhirete imanları kalmamış bulunmasındandır.

ELMALILI:2:86/r7.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:2:86/r7.speaker: author
ELMALILI:2:86/r7.claim: For a few days of transient life they risk every evil, alter God's books for a few coins, and permit every wrong against His servants.
ELMALILI:2:86/r7.anchor: beş on para için Allah’ın kitaplarını tahrif eder, ibâdullaha karşı her fenâlığı tecviz eder

ELMALILI:2:86/r8.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:2:86/r8.speaker: author
ELMALILI:2:86/r8.claim: Their “few numbered days” wish is born of unbelief; souls enveloped by evil deeds remain in Hell forever and suffer the severest punishment.
ELMALILI:2:86/r8.anchor: böyle seyyiât ile muhât olanlar elbette muhalled fi’n-nâr olacaklar ve en şedid azabı göreceklerdir.

ELMALILI:2:86/r9.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:2:86/r9.speaker: author
ELMALILI:2:86/r9.claim: After completing this warning, the commentary turns to their hostility toward the Messenger to further explain their deserving eternal punishment.
ELMALILI:2:86/r9.anchor: Bu hükm-i inzar bu suretle itmam edildikten sonra şimdi de bunların Resûlullah’a karşı suikastlarına işaretle

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:85/r6.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:85/r6.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:85/r6.claim: Their preference for worldly advantage at the cost of the afterlife brings unrelieved punishment and no help, alongside the worldly disgrace described for their conduct.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:85/r6.anchor: bu tutumları yüzünden dünyada perişan olacakları, âhirette de azap görecekleri haber verilmektedir.

NAHHAS:v1p244/r6.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p244/r6.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v1p244/r6.claim: The opening of the verse is a subject-predicate construction.

BURHAN:v1p128/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p128/r3.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p128/r3.claim: Zarkashi catalogs further differences between parallel passages: connective particles and forms such as after/from, to/for, and then/fa; this excerpt lists them without explaining each variation.
BURHAN:v1p128/r3.anchor: ومنه قوله تعالى فى البقرة ﴿ وإذ قلنا ادخلوا هذه القرية فكلوا ﴾ بالفاء وفى الأعراف بالواو

ITQAN:v1p225/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v1p225/r5.speaker: author
ITQAN:v1p225/r5.claim: A stop permitted for a reason is supported both by the causal-resulting فَاء in the next clause, which favors connection, and by the verb's independent sentence structure.
ITQAN:v1p225/r5.anchor: لأن الفاء في قوله ﴿ فلا يخفف عنهم ﴾ تقتضي التسبب والجزاء وذلك يوجب الوصل

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p586/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p586/r3.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p586/r3.claim: Naṣr can mean protection or prevention from punishment; the cited passages ask who can shield people from God’s torment.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p586/r3.anchor: أحدها : المنع . ومنه قوله تعالى في البقرة

JISHUMI:v1p478/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p478/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v1p478/r1.claim: The author regards the punishment warning as a benefit for morally responsible people, deterring them from actions that earn it.
JISHUMI:v1p478/r1.anchor: وجميع ذلك لطف للمكلف، وتحذير أن يعمل ما يستحق به ذلك

JISHUMI:v1p478/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p478/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v1p478/r2.claim: Their punishment cannot be lightened or delayed, and no helper can deliver them.
JISHUMI:v1p478/r2.anchor: وتدل على أن عذاب الله لا تخفيف فيه ولا إنظار، ولا ناصر يخلص منه

JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r1.claim: The Jews previously discussed exchanged the afterlife for worldly life by abandoning the religion and the Messenger's teaching for disbelief and worldly adornment; the buying and selling is metaphorical.
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r1.anchor: ليس ههنا بيع ولا شراء، وإنما هو توسع، أي تركوا الدين وما جاء به الرسول

JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r2.claim: Their punishment is not reduced; reduction could mean ending it or easing its components.
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r2.anchor: أي لا ينقص، والنقصان بوجهين: بانقطاعه، أو بتخفيف أجزائه

JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r3.claim: They will have no helper to rescue them from punishment.
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r3.anchor: أي لا يجدون ناصرا يخلصهم من العذاب

JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r4.claim: The fāʾ either coordinates the clause within the relative clause beginning with اشتروا, or gives a consequence with an implied clause; the author prefers coordination because it follows the text without omission.
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r4.anchor: والأول أوجه؛ لأنه على سياقة الكلام من غير حذف ولا إخلال

JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r5.speaker: أبو علي
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r5.claim: Lightness and heaviness may be explained by the constituent parts of a thing.
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r5.anchor: قيل: يرجع إلى الأجزاء، عن أبي علي

JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r6.speaker: أبو هاشم
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r6.claim: Abu Hashim relates lightness and heaviness to the forces inherent in an object; the author calls this the correct view because equal parts can differ in weight.
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r6.anchor: قيل: إلى الاعتمادات اللازمة فيه، عن أبي هاشم، وهو الصحيح

JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r7.speaker: أبو علي
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r7.claim: Abu Ali says God's support is given to believers as a reward; the author calls this correct.
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r7.anchor: قيل: نصرة الله تكون للمؤمنين لأنه ثواب، عن أبي علي، وهو الصحيح

JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r8.speaker: أبو بكر أحمد بن علي
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r8.claim: Abu Bakr Ahmad ibn Ali says divine support may be reward or not, and a sinner may also be supported, as support is commanded.
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r8.anchor: ويجوز أن ينصر الفاسق، وقد أمرنا به، عن أبي بكر أحمد بن علي

JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r9.claim: The verse indicates that these people have no intercessor: if they did, their punishment would be lightened.
JISHUMI:v1p476#2/r9.anchor: الآية تدل على أنه لا شافع لهم؛ إذ لو كان يخفف عنهم لنصرهم

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p494/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p494/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p494/r1.claim: In the usual Quranic construction, ب marks what is given up in a purchase; thus 2:175 depicts exchanging guidance for error and forgiveness for punishment.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p494/r1.anchor: يفيد سياقها في تسعة عشر موضعا أنها بمعنى الشراء، والباء فيها دخلت على المبيع المتروك
